hero.headline: Where care becomes quality.
hero.description: Explore the people, spaces and working practices behind our manufacturing operation in Kampong Speu, with a focus on clean, orderly work and consistent quality.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative image of noodle production; not the LM Manufacturing factory

introText: Our Kampong Speu site brings together factory, warehouse, office and support areas. Each area has a clear role in supporting clean, organized and responsible daily operations.

facilities.title: Factory
facilities.text: The core area for manufacturing operations, where teams follow organized working practices and focus on consistent product quality.

facilities.title: Warehouse
facilities.text: A dedicated area for organizing raw materials and finished products to support clean, orderly and responsible daily operations.

facilities.title: Office and support areas
facilities.text: Spaces where teams coordinate people, information and support activities that keep the operation moving.

capabilitiesText: We are steadily developing our instant noodle manufacturing capabilities, systems and working practices.
qualityTitle: Hygiene and quality in every step
qualityText: Clear procedures, clean and orderly working practices, careful daily work and coordinated teams help us strengthen consistency across our manufacturing operation.
safetyText: We promote clear responsibilities, orderly working methods and daily habits that support a cleaner, safer and more dependable workplace.
